comments.text: My tip is to buy a hanging rod for the back seat to hang your clothes. It will give you space and offer some privacy when you sleep in the back. I parked in quiet suburban neighborhoods after dark and left in the morning before dawn. No one bothered me. The toughest part is loneliness. Life got better when I bought a RV.
